blocks.raw: ## Accounts
blocks.text: Accounts

blocks.raw: Each account must be assigned an `accountHolderType` during initial creation, the accepted values are as follows:
blocks.text: Each account must be assigned an accountHolderType during initial creation, the accepted values are as follows:

blocks.raw: `A` Institutional – An institutional account as defined in FINRA Rule 4512(c)
blocks.text: A Institutional – An institutional account as defined in FINRA Rule 4512(c)

blocks.raw: `E` Employee – An employee or associated person of the industry member
blocks.text: E Employee – An employee or associated person of the industry member

blocks.raw: `F` Foreign - A non-broker-dealer foreign affiliate or non-reporting foreign broker-dealer
blocks.text: F Foreign - A non-broker-dealer foreign affiliate or non-reporting foreign broker-dealer

blocks.raw: `I` Individual – An account that does not meet the definition of “institution” as defined in FINRA Rule 4512(c) and is also not a proprietary account.
blocks.text: I Individual – An account that does not meet the definition of “institution” as defined in FINRA Rule 4512(c) and is also not a proprietary account.

blocks.raw: `O` Market Making – Please refer to CAT FAQ C5 and B68
blocks.text: O Market Making – Please refer to CAT FAQ C5 and B68

blocks.raw: `V` Firm agency average price account
blocks.text: V Firm agency average price account

blocks.raw: `P` Other Proprietary account
blocks.text: P Other Proprietary account

blocks.raw: `X` Error – Error account of the firm
blocks.text: X Error – Error account of the firm

## Orders

    "accountNo": "ABCD000123",
    "orderType": "MARKET",

blocks.raw: ### PATCH
blocks.text: PATCH

blocks.raw: An additional object is required to be appended to the cancel request:
blocks.text: An additional object is required to be appended to the cancel request:

blocks.raw: `initiator` The party who initiated the cancel request. Acceptable values are `C` (Customer) or `F` (Firm)
blocks.text: initiator The party who initiated the cancel request. Acceptable values are C (Customer) or F (Firm)

blocks.raw: `requestedTimestamp` The timestamp indicating when the client received the cancel request
blocks.text: requestedTimestamp The timestamp indicating when the client received the cancel request

blocks.raw: `manualCancel` Whether the cancel request was received outside of automated processes
blocks.text: manualCancel Whether the cancel request was received outside of automated processes

blocks.raw: `comment` A freeform text field for any additional notes
blocks.text: comment A freeform text field for any additional notes

blocks.raw: ## Daily Order Cancel File
blocks.text: Daily Order Cancel File

blocks.raw: Since it's not feasible for a client to provide an internal order cancel completion timestamp in the PATCH request before receiving an acknowledgment from DW, an SFTP folder will be provisioned to allow clients to easily upload a daily file containing completion timestamps. The file format must follow the CSV template provided by DW. These files should be uploaded on business days after market close and must include all cancel requests completed between 4:15 PM ET on the previous trading day and 4:15 PM ET on the current trading day.
